package rulefixtures

import (
	"errors"

	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for repository_returns_http_status_errors: Repositories that construct transport-layer error objects or status-code wrappers.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

type File struct {
	ID       uint   `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	Filename string `gorm:"size:256"`
	Path     string `gorm:"size:512"`
	Size     int64
}

type RepoError struct {
	StatusCode int
	Message    string
	Err        error
}

func (e *RepoError) Error() string {
	return e.Message
}

var (
	ErrNotFound = &RepoError{StatusCode: 404, Message: "resource not found"}
	ErrConflict = &RepoError{StatusCode: 409, Message: "resource already exists"}
	ErrForbidden = &RepoError{StatusCode: 403, Message: "access denied"}
)

type FileRepo struct {
	db *gorm.DB
}

func NewFileRepo(db *gorm.DB) *FileRepo {
	return &FileRepo{db: db}
}

func (r *FileRepo) FindByID(id uint) (*File, error) {
	var file File
	err := r.db.First(&file, id).Error
	if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
		return nil, ErrNotFound
	}
	return &file, err
}

func (r *FileRepo) Create(filename, path string, size int64) (*File, *RepoError) {
	existing := r.db.Where("path = ?", path).First(&File{}).Error
	if existing == nil {
		return nil, ErrConflict
	}

	file := &File{Filename: filename, Path: path, Size: size}
	if err := r.db.Create(file).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, &RepoError{StatusCode: 500, Message: err.Error()}
	}
	return file, nil
}

var _ = errors.Is
